senses.definition: A lady, especially a noblewoman; the title given to a lady in Italy.

quotes.text: What are the songs of Italy, sung as they are by the donnas of the scenic board, but a replication of squalls and quavers, infinitely more annoying than the gibberish of crones[…]
quotes.reference: 1837, Thomas Tod Stoddart, Angling reminiscences, page 65:

quotes.text: In Don Giovannis three female characters, the diverse spectrum of womanhood is rendered complete: the great opera seria character of the avenging Donna Anna, the sentimental and spurned Donna' Elvira, and the crafty but sympathetic peasant girl Zerlina.
